notes.title: Launch day!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings everyone![/b]

I won't stall and just say: [b]that the 20th of December is a launch day[/b]. All levels are finally ready to play!

I could've finished this game way faster, but as my university education started, I simply didn't have enough time for the game. In advance, I want to say that all levels are simple ideas. They can be challenging, but also be completed pretty fast, except for "Basement". The Basement level took longer to make and, I guess, has more content than the other levels. You can play any level you want, they are all available to play, no need to unlock any, you can play them as you wish.

I also want to apologize for some levels having similar concepts. I didn't want to make 5 completely different small games with different mechanics. I wanted to make 5 levels with similar ideas but have different environments and enemies. But as the development progressed I realized that the levels are kinda repetitive and decided to make some levels with different ideas.

[i]If you find any bugs, you can report them by starting a discussion in the Community Hub and I will try to fix them.[/i]
[b]
I would also really appreciate it if you would leave your review for the game, positive or negative, I really want to hear your opinion on the game, so I can improve and not repeat my mistakes in the future.[/b]
[b]
Anyway, I hope that you have a great time playing the game! See you on the launch day :)[/b]

notes.title: Demo release!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

I want to announce that [b]the Demo version of the game is now available[/b]. You will be able to play the first level - Forest. Forgotten Fears is the second project that I am developing completely alone, so [b]any feedback will be appreciated[/b], it will allow me to fix any issues, rework something, or even add a new mechanic you would like to see in the level. Your feedback will allow me to understand my mistakes that I will try to avoid in the future.[b]

I hope you will have fun playing the Demo![/b]
